metadata.title: CI/CD Static Scan Non-Blocking and Missing .secrets.baseline

transformations: SAST detects vulnerability — pipeline continues (abort_on_failure: false)
npm audit passes (different scope — dependency CVEs only)
sign-artifact: vulnerable artifact is cryptographically signed
sinks: Signed artifact with unreviewed SAST findings deployed to production users

privilege_boundary.achieved_privilege: Code reaches production artifact (signed) without SAST gatekeeping

impact.description: SAST-detected vulnerabilities reach production users. XSS, path traversal, and injection vulnerabilities can be introduced and deployed without automated blocking. Part of AC-002 (CI/CD supply chain bypass with VULN-005).

prerequisites: Developer commit access (insider or compromised account)
Knowledge that static-scan is non-blocking (readable from pipeline YAML)

compensating_controls: npm audit compliance-checks step compensates for dependency CVEs (not code flaws)

remediation.fix_approach: Change abort_on_failure: false to abort_on_failure: true on static-scan step. Generate and commit .secrets.baseline: detect-secrets scan > .secrets.baseline. If blocking SAST deferred, document risk acceptance and add mandatory manual review.

history.note: abort_on_failure:false on static-scan step allows vulnerable code past security gate; .secrets.baseline missing for detect-secrets

Confirmed. abort_on_failure:false is explicit in pipeline YAML. .secrets.baseline absent from repo. CVSS MEDIUM 7.7 (requires commit access + AC:H for active exploitation). Part of AC-002 supply chain chain.
